_comment: Skill routing policy. Membership comes from the filesystem — setup globs each
set directory — so this file never drifts from what is actually on disk.
It declares only what cannot be inferred: which hosts a set feeds, and the
Each entry is an individual symlink back into this repo, so editing the
installed file edits the tracked file. See PLAN.md for the reasoning.

codex/do-pr.why: Uses the Codex-native stack (codex review, ~/.codex/agents/, ~/.codex/prompts/). OpenCode has none of these, so it is never linked there.

shared/find-skills.why: Retired from Claude profiles 2026-09-02 (never used there); Codex/OpenCode keep it.

sogni.why: Ships its own SKILL.md, references/ and sub-skills via npm. Symlinked from the global install so 'npm update -g' takes effect; never vendored.
